# owner: platform
import unittest
from rosterkit.notices import absence_notice
from rosterkit.models import Mark, Student
from rosterkit.errors import ProjectError
from datetime import date

STUDENT = Student("s1", "Lovelace", "Ada", "A")
MIXED = [
    Mark("s1", date(2026, 3, 5), "absent"),
    Mark("s1", date(2026, 3, 4), "present"),
    Mark("s1", date(2026, 3, 2), "absent")
]
EXPECTED = "Ada Lovelace missed 2 day(s): 2026-03-02, 2026-03-05."


class NoticeTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_lists_sorted_absent_days(self):
        self.assertEqual(absence_notice(STUDENT, MIXED), EXPECTED)

    def test_other_student_rejected(self):
        with self.assertRaises(ProjectError):
            absence_notice(STUDENT, [Mark("s2", date(2026, 3, 2), "absent")])

    def test_no_absences_rejected(self):
        with self.assertRaises(ProjectError):
            absence_notice(STUDENT, [Mark("s1", date(2026, 3, 2), "late")])
